{{Quote|We make interstellar travel less exciting.|The slogan of a Lantillian shipping firm|<ref name="TEA" />}}
'''Lantillies''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Lantillies system/Legends|Lantillies system]] and the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Located along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and at the head of the [[Randon Run/Legends|Randon Run]], Lantillies was heavily involved in the shipping and [[Starship/Legends|shipbuilding]] industries, and its [[Human/Legends|Human]] natives were well-known for their emphasis on reliability over elegance. Lantillies was [[Battle of Lantillies|conquered]] by the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]] early in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, though the planet was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] through much of the government's history. Lantillies later became a stronghold of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] of [[25 ABY/Legends|25]]&ndash;[[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Lantillies was located in the [[Lantillies system/Legends|Lantillies system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Lantillian [[Sector/Legends|sector]], Lantillies fell within the boundaries of the region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] commonly known as the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]]. A bustling [[City/Legends|city]]-world, Lantillies was a major player in shipping and [[Starship/Legends|shipbuilding]] industries, as it was located along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and sat at the end of the [[Randon Run/Legends|Randon Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that linked Lantillies with [[Randon/Legends|Randon]], the capital of the nearby [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:Lantillian_sector.png|thumb|left|150px|Lantillies was the capital of the Lantillian sector.]]
Lantillies was discovered by the [[The galaxy/Legends|greater galaxy]] sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000]]<ref name="TEA" />&ndash;[[24,000 BBY]], and early on in the [[Tionese War]] between 24,000&ndash;[[23,900 BBY]], the forces of the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]] [[Battle of Lantillies|conquered]] Lantillies during their march up the Perlemian Trade Route towards the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Lantillies was a part of the Republic by [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], and during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] of [[3976 BBY|3976]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]], the Lantillies system was the site of a [[Battle of the Lantillies system|Republic victory]] against the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Lantillian Planetary Security Forces]] were responsible for protecting Lantillies in the later years of the Republic.<ref name="Warfare" />

The [[Lantillian ShipWrights/Legends|Lantillian ShipWrights]] corporation was based on Lantillies during the final years of the Republic, though in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] the company was forced to recall a number of their [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Haulers]] when it was discovered that they had malfunctioning [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[7Y4 sensor suite]]. Fabritech blamed the Lantillies shipping industry, and Lantillian ShipWrights asked their customers to return the vessels to the [[Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood/Legends|Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood]] for refitting.<ref name="Holonet">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|business/1337_3.html|Lantillian Recalls GX1 Short Hauler}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] between 22&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Lantillies served as the headquarters of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Twelfth Army/Legends|Twelfth Army]] under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Therbon/Legends|Therbon]].<ref name="Warfare" />

When the Republic was replaced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in 19 BBY, Lantillies and its shipping guilds remained neutral in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. However, Lantillian natives [[Barlon Hightower/Legends|Barlon Hightower]] and [[Bren Quersey/Legends|Bren Quersey]] flew as [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for the Alliance, as Hightower joined the Alliance after he came to believe that there was no room for neutrality in the civil war. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[New Republic Third Fleet|Third Fleet]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&mdash;the government that succeeded the Alliance&mdash;joined together with the defense forces of nearby [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] to establish a beachhead along the Perlemian at Lantillies.<ref name="Warfare" /> By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the region of space around Lantillies had an average population of 10 to 100 billion sentients per inhabited planet, and Lantillies was a stronghold of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] against the extra-galactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] between [[25 ABY/Legends|25]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

Lantillies had been considered as a potential candidate for one of the Lost Thrones of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Lantillians, as Lantillies' inhabitants were known, were primarily [[Human/Legends|Human]], though they were well-known for their disinterest in flashiness or elegance in starship design, as they placed a priority on reliability. Lantillians were also rather open-minded about [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species, freely admitting them into their companies and guilds without prejudice.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lantillies has received a number of mentions in early role-playing guides, as several variations of ships bore the "Lantillian" description, and the planet was greatly expanded upon in the [[2009]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
